title: Pullback comparison for same-length rational Weil return operators
statement:
Fix $k_0=\mathbf F_q$, an algebraic closure $k$, a prime $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}k_0$, an algebraic closure $\Qlb/\mathbf Q_\ell$, and a finite coefficient field $E\subset\Qlb$. Let $f_0:X_0\to Y_0$ be a morphism of separated finite-type $k_0$-schemes and $f:X\to Y$ its base change to $k$. Put $s=\operatorname{Spec}k$, and let $g_X,g_Y,g_s$ be geometric Frobenius [def-weil-frobenius-detailed]. Work in the framework rationalized constructible categories, with pullbacks [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], point fibres [def-weil-finite-coefficient-point], and the specified rationalized comparison families [lem-trf-integral-pullback-comparison-realization]. Choose $\bar z:s\to X$ and $\bar x=f\bar z:s\to Y$, and $n\geq1$ such that $g_X^n\bar z=\bar z g_s^n$ and $g_Y^n\bar x=\bar x g_s^n$. Put $G_X=Lg_X^*$, $G_Y=Lg_Y^*$, $J_z=\operatorname{Fib}_{s,E}L\bar z^*$ and $J_x=\operatorname{Fib}_{s,E}L\bar x^*$. Let $c_M:J_zLf^*M\xrightarrow{\sim}J_xM$ be $\operatorname{Fib}_{s,E}$ of the inverse pullback compositor for $f\bar z$, and let $\beta_r:G_X^rLf^*\xrightarrow{\sim}Lf^*G_Y^r$ be the comparison for $fg_X^r=g_Y^rf$, using the associative identifications of functor powers. Write $t^X_{n,N}:J_zN\to J_zG_X^nN$ and $t^Y_{n,M}:J_xM\to J_xG_Y^nM$ for the normalized successive point transports [lem-trf-local-frobenius-transport-normalization].

For every $M\in D^b_c(Y,E)$ one has
$$c_{G_Y^nM}\,J_z(\beta_{n,M})\,t^X_{n,Lf^*M}=t^Y_{n,M}\,c_M.$$
For every $E$-Weil complex $(M,\theta_Y)$ [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex], give $Lf^*M$ the structure $\theta_X=Lf^*(\theta_Y)\beta_{1,M}$. Its iterates [def-weil-local-frobenius-trace] satisfy, for every $r\geq1$,
$$\theta_X^{[r]}=Lf^*(\theta_Y^{[r]})\beta_{r,M}.$$
With $R^X_n=J_z(\theta_X^{[n]})t^X_{n,Lf^*M}$ and $R^Y_n=J_x(\theta_Y^{[n]})t^Y_{n,M}$, the resulting equality in $D^b_{\mathrm{fd}}(E)$ is
$$c_MR^X_n=R^Y_nc_M.$$
No finite Tor-amplitude condition on reductions or integral Weil-stable lattice is assumed.

proof.text:
Write $F=Lf^*$, $P_z=L\bar z^*$, $P_x=L\bar x^*$, $U=Lg_s^*$ and $B=\operatorname{Fib}_{s,E}$. Compose right to left. Let $C:P_zF\xrightarrow{\sim}P_x$ be the inverse compositor, so $c=BC$. The affine formula [def-weil-frobenius-detailed] gives $fg_X=g_Yf$: both ring maps send $a\otimes b$ to $f_0^\#(a)\otimes\gamma(b)$. Iteration gives $fg_X^r=g_Y^rf$. For $v_X:U^nP_z\to P_zG_X^n$ and $v_Y:U^nP_x\to P_xG_Y^n$ from the assumed returns, associativity of the specified comparisons [lem-trf-integral-pullback-comparison-realization] gives
$$C_{G_Y^nM}P_z(\beta_{n,M})v_{X,FM}=v_{Y,M}U^n(C_M).$$
To see the pasting explicitly, expand $v_X,v_Y$ as the inverse compositor for $\bar z g_s^n$, respectively $\bar x g_s^n$, followed by the compositor for $g_X^n\bar z$, respectively $g_Y^n\bar x$; expand $\beta_n$ as the inverse compositor for $fg_X^n$ followed by that for $g_Y^nf$. Both sides are the reassociation along $f g_X^n\bar z=g_Y^nf\bar z=f\bar z g_s^n$. The cited coherence includes equality of scheme maps and finite iterations, also after rationalization. Here $B$ is the functor of [def-weil-finite-coefficient-point].

proof.text:
Put $I_N^{(0)}=1$ and $I_N^{(j+1)}=\iota_{U^jN}I_N^{(j)}$. Naturality of $\iota$ [lem-weil-frobenius-point-transport-natural] implies naturality of $I^{(j)}$ by induction: the base is the identity; for a point-category map $a:N\to N'$, the successor equality is
$$BU^{j+1}(a)\iota_{U^jN}I_N^{(j)}=\iota_{U^jN'}BU^j(a)I_N^{(j)}=\iota_{U^jN'}I_{N'}^{(j)}B(a).$$
Apply this with $j=n$ and $a=C_M:P_zFM\to P_xM$. With the normalized successive transport construction specified in the statement [lem-trf-local-frobenius-transport-normalization], $t^X_{n,FM}=B(v_{X,FM})I_{P_zFM}^{(n)}$ and $t^Y_{n,M}=B(v_{Y,M})I_{P_xM}^{(n)}$. Apply $B$ to Step 1 and compose with $I_{P_zFM}^{(n)}$; substituting the naturality equation gives $c_{G_Y^nM}J_z(\beta_{n,M})t^X_{n,FM}=t^Y_{n,M}c_M$. Only the defining construction of normalized transport is used; no extra choice of a rational-point representative is needed.

proof.text:
Associativity of [lem-trf-integral-pullback-comparison-realization] gives
$$\beta_{r+1,M}=\beta_{r,G_YM}G_X^r(\beta_{1,M})\quad(r\geq1).$$
Indeed, factor the commuting square through $fg_X^rg_X=g_Y^rfg_X=g_Y^rg_Yf$; its two successive comparison factors are exactly those displayed. Naturality of the same specified comparison gives, for $u:G_YM\to M$,
$$\beta_{r,M}G_X^r(Fu)=F(G_Y^ru)\beta_{r,G_YM}.$$
These equations are in the rationalized categories, using the associative identifications of functor powers.

proof.text:
The isomorphism $\theta_X=F(\theta_Y)\beta_1$ is a Weil structure [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex]. Induct on $r\geq1$ to prove $\theta_X^{[r]}=F(\theta_Y^{[r]})\beta_{r,M}$. The base is its definition. For the successor, the recursion [def-weil-local-frobenius-trace], the induction hypothesis, and Step 3 with $u=\theta_Y$ give
$$\begin{aligned}
\theta_X^{[r+1]}&=F(\theta_Y^{[r]})\beta_{r,M}G_X^r(F\theta_Y)G_X^r(\beta_{1,M})\\
&=F(\theta_Y^{[r]})F(G_Y^r\theta_Y)\beta_{r,G_YM}G_X^r(\beta_{1,M})\\
&=F(\theta_Y^{[r+1]})\beta_{r+1,M}.
\end{aligned}$$
Thus every positive iterate has the claimed form.

proof.text:
Naturality of the inverse compositor from [lem-trf-integral-pullback-comparison-realization], followed by $B$, says $c_MJ_z(Fu)=J_x(u)c_{G_Y^nM}$ for $u:G_Y^nM\to M$. Take $u=\theta_Y^{[n]}$. Step 4, this equation, and Step 2 give
$$\begin{aligned}
c_MR^X_n
&=c_MJ_z(F\theta_Y^{[n]})J_z(\beta_{n,M})t^X_{n,FM}\\
&=J_x(\theta_Y^{[n]})c_{G_Y^nM}J_z(\beta_{n,M})t^X_{n,FM}\\
&=J_x(\theta_Y^{[n]})t^Y_{n,M}c_M=R^Y_nc_M.
\end{aligned}$$
The values lie in $D^b_{\mathrm{fd}}(E)$ by [def-weil-finite-coefficient-point]. Every operation on the Weil map occurs in the rational category; neither an integral lift of that map nor finite Tor-amplitude of a reduction was used.
